Hi, I was billed two times for order ORD-1001 on my card this morning. Please reverse the duplicate charge today, my bank balance is now too low to pay rent.

Thanks, Marcus", "expected_category": "billing", "expected_urgency": "low"}, {"id": 3, "order_id": "ORD-1003", "email": "Subject: Checkout crashes on payment

Leo", "expected_category": "bug", "expected_urgency": "medium"}, {"id": 5, "order_id": "ORD-1005", "email": "Subject: Change shipping address?

Sofia", "expected_category": "how-to", "expected_urgency": "low"}, {"id": 6, "order_id": "ORD-1006", "email": "Subject: Setting up webhooks

We want to connect order events (like ORD-1006) to our own system. Where do I set up a webhook and which events can I subscribe to? We plan to go live next week.

Dmitri, Acme Tools", "expected_category": "how-to", "expected_urgency": "medium"}, {"id": 7, "order_id": "ORD-1007", "email": "Subject: Partnership idea

Hi, I run a small newsletter and loved my order ORD-1007. Would you be open to a co-marketing partnership? Happy to chat whenever suits you.

Nadia", "expected_category": "other", "expected_urgency": "low"}, {"id": 8, "order_id": "ORD-1008", "email": "Subject: Refund not received

You approved a refund for ORD-1008 ten days ago but the money still has not arrived in my account. Can you check what is going on? I would like it sorted this week.

Carlos", "expected_category": "billing", "expected_urgency": "medium"}, {"id": 9, "order_id": "ORD-1009", "email": "Subject: LOCKED OUT and data gone

My account is locked and all my saved orders including ORD-1009 have disappeared from the dashboard. I run my whole shop from this. Please fix ASAP!!

Hannah", "expected_category": "bug", "expected_urgency": "high"}, {"id": 10, "order_id": "ORD-1010", "email": "Subject: Feedback on packaging

Order ORD-1010 arrived fine, but the box was much bigger than needed. Just wanted to pass this on as feedback, no action needed.

Tom", "expected_category": "other", "expected_urgency": "low"}];
return tests.map(t => ({ json: t }));

options.systemMessage:
You are a support ticket triager for an online shop. You receive one customer email.

Steps:
1. If the email mentions an order ID like ORD-1234, you MUST call the tool lookup_order_status once with that exact order ID before answering.
2. Then reply with ONLY one JSON object, no markdown, no extra text, with exactly these keys:
{"category":"billing|bug|how-to|other","urgency":"low|medium|high","summary":"two short lines separated by \n","draft_reply":"a polite reply to the customer that uses the order status if you looked it up"}

Rules: category must be exactly one of billing, bug, how-to, other. urgency must be exactly one of low, medium, high. High means money or access is blocked right now or a deadline is today.FINAL ANSWER RULE: After using the tool, your final reply must be ONLY the JSON object. It must start with { and end with }. Never write a letter, greeting, or "Dear". Put the customer reply inside the draft_reply key.

parameters.description: Look up the status of a customer order. Input: the order ID as plain text, for example ORD-1001. Returns JSON with status, carrier and ETA.
